title: Agentic World Modeling for Agent Test-time Scaling without Environment Replica
abstract: arXiv:2610.40927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model agents by sampling and selecting among multiple candidate trajectories, but common realizations assume that these trajectories can be executed in parallel. This assumption breaks in realistic deployments, where enterprise workspaces and cloud services are shared and persistent, costly or infeasible to replicate, and actions may introduce irreversible side effects or cross-trajectory interference. Existing generative world models avoid direct execution, but typically compress environment state into a single prompt, limiting their ability to reliably simulate transitions under partial observability. Instead, we introduce Agentic World Modeling (AWM), which reformulates next-observation prediction as a multi-turn evidence-acquisition task. translated_title: 无需环境副本的智能体式世界建模，用于智能体测试时扩展
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展通过在多条候选轨迹之间进行采样与选择来提升大型语言模型智能体的表现，但常见的实现方式假设这些轨迹可以被并行执行。这一假设在现实部署中并不成立：企业工作空间和云服务是共享且持久存在的，对其进行复制的代价高昂甚至不可行，而且动作可能带来不可逆的副作用或跨轨迹的相互干扰。现有的生成式世界模型虽然避免了对环境的直接执行，但通常将环境状态压缩到单一提示中，限制了其在部分可观测条件下可靠模拟状态转移的能力。为此，我们提出了智能体式世界建模，将下一观测预测重新表述为一个多轮证据获取任务。针对每个假设动作，一个智能体化的模拟器通过安全的只读接口自适应地查询真实环境，并对返回的
tldr: 提出智能体式世界建模（AWM），将下一观测预测重构为多轮证据获取任务，通过安全只读接口自适应查询真实环境来模拟候选动作，从而无需复制环境即可实现大语言模型智能体的测试时扩展。
en_tdlr: Proposes Agentic World Modeling (AWM), which reformulates next-observation prediction as a multi-turn evidence-acquisition task that adaptively queries the real environment via safe read-only interfaces, enabling test-time scaling of LLM agents without replicating the environment.
